description: Use when writing backend or API-key integration code for the Didit Fraud Check API and the IP Risk API. Use when the user wants to run one server-side fraud or identity risk check over an email, phone, government ID number, tax number, IP address or selfie; quote a check's price before running it with the plan endpoint; combine email risk, phone risk, IP risk, social enrichment, database validation, private network history and the global fraud network in one request; read separate identity, contact, device/network, behavioral and fraud-network risk dimensions and an approve/review/reject recommendation; bind a selfie to a Brazilian CPF; retrieve a stored check by check_id; make idempotent retries with client_reference; or risk-score a single IP address (geolocation, VPN/Tor, data center, claimed-country mismatch) using Didit.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
